title: P25: three radios taking turns on a talkgroup
description: P25 Phase 1 C4FM voice calls on 453.6125 MHz, NAC 0x293, TG 101 (HDU, LDU1 link control with the source unit ID, LDU2 clear, placeholder IMBE frames with valid FEC, TDU / TDULC): unit 2010621 (60 deg) twice, unit 3250 (200 deg), unit 1234567 (300 deg), each at its own carrier offset and level. Expect talkers 2010621, 3250 and 1234567 at those bearings.

title: P25 Phase 2: three radios' inbound bursts, two of them at the same time
description: P25 Phase 2 TDMA inbound (radios to the site, H-CPM bursts) on 453.6125 MHz, scrambled (WACN BEE00 / system 14C / NAC 293, recovered by the decoder from the bursts): unit 6001 -> TG 601 on logical channel 0 (40 deg, +200 Hz) and, at the same time, unit 6002 -> TG 602 encrypted (AES-256, muted) on logical channel 1 (160 deg, -150 Hz, 3 dB weaker) - their 28 ms bursts alternate every 30 ms; then unit 6003 -> TG 601 on logical channel 0 (280 deg, +50 Hz). Every checked burst is a packet of its radio. Expect talkers 6001, 6002 and 6003 at those bearings.

title: P25 Phase 2: a site's traffic channel with calls on both timeslots, then a Phase 1 call
description: A P25 Phase 2 TDMA traffic channel (H-DQPSK, the site at 120 deg, +140 Hz) on 854.7625 MHz, scrambled (WACN BEE00 / system 14C / NAC 293, recovered by the decoder from a traffic burst): unit 2101 -> TG 101 in the clear on logical channel 0, overlapping it unit 2102 -> unit 2103 encrypted (AES-256, muted) on logical channel 1; then the same channel carries a P25 Phase 1 call of unit 2104 -> TG 101. On the site's output every unit's bearing is the site's. Expect talkers 2101, 2102 and 2104 at 120 deg.
